The '''Refugee camp''' is activated once you meet {{NPC|Marquis Teodoro Jr}}. He appears at your bedside when you wake up, the first time you sleep after unlocking the [[Church]]. He takes you to the camp, which is located in [[Forest near the river]] (directly North of [[Sweet Home]]).

Here you are able to increase the camp population, meet new NPCs with new questlines to earn rewards such as the [[Universal bag]] and so on. To build any new structures and progress through the quests, first, you need to make the refugees happy.

{{Item|Refugee Happiness}} is calculated by combining the {{Happiness}} happiness and the {{Item|refugee camp}} capacity. The camp starts with a base 0 out of {{Item|Refugee Happiness|3}}. {{Item|Refugee Happiness}} decreases if food and water are missing and is capped by the {{Item|refugee camp}} capacity, which can be increased by camp development.

==Food and Water Consumption==
Each person in the camp consumes a total of {{Item|water|3}} and {{Energy|2=30}} of [[Items#food|food]] each day. There are 5 time intervals per day (one every 90 seconds). In each time interval, {{Energy|2=6}} of food and 0.6 water per person are removed from the stockpile.

The game consumes the items with the most {{Energy}} value until the amount of energy required is reached. For example, when the camp has 4 refugees, it needs to consume {{Energy|2=24}}, if there's cake in the stockpile, it will consume 1 cake, wasting {{Energy|2=76}}. The same applies to water.

==Quests==
[[Cook]] appears once you build the [[Fence Supplies For Garden]] area and gives task of building her a [[GoC Cooking table|kitchen]] (crafts food automated from the storage).

[[Undertaker]] appears after you built and filled the third tent. She trades gravestones and recipes to build the more advanced gravestones.

After building and filling the fourth tent [[Tanner]] will appear and ask you to build a [[Tanner's workplace|workplace]] for her. She sells different kind of bags.

==Camp upgrades==
Each upgrade requires sufficient refugee satisfaction as well as the standard materials.
